frame_metadata.gps_note: First take with GPS on every frame. App frames carry a 9-key GPS block written by the F0 build; stock-camera HEICs carry Apple's full 15-key block. Both bind the frame to the Met to within a few metres.

source_note: App frames are camera-roll copies (Image Capture over USB) bound to the manifest by capture time with tools/manifest/bind-frames.py — see derived/2026-09-20-met-frames.json.

expected.title: Traveling boat rowing (O)
expected.title_note: '(O)' is the Meketre model's letter, part of the label title. The API title is 'Travelling Boat being Rowed' — different spelling of travelling, different construction, no letter.
expected.period: Dynasty 12, early reign of Amenemhat I
expected.date_edtf_note: BCE years are astronomical: 375 BCE is -0374. Ranges are intervals; '~' marks each end when the label says 'ca.'. A named span like 'late 6th century' is written as the conventional interval and noted in date_raw.

expected.credit_line: Rogers Fund and Edward S. Harkness Gift, 1920

differ.title: see title_note
differ.medium: label 'Painted wood', API 'Wood, paint, gesso, linen twine and linen fabric'

traps.mma_1101_is_not_an_accession: '(MMA 1101)' is the excavation's tomb number, parenthesised exactly like an accession, three lines above the real one. A locator keyed on 'parenthesised number near the end' has two hits. The credit-line position and the year agreement (1920 ↔ 20.) pick the right one.
traps.parenthetical_in_title: '(O)' — a single capital letter in parentheses is title content here. Don't strip parentheticals from titles.
